providerAnnotation: "This job failed because of a scheduled macOS 14 runner image brownout. macOS 14 runner images will be retired on November 2, 2026. For migration options and the brownout schedule, see https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/13518"
scopedAiDecision: Astra chief approved macos-14 to macos-15; preserve ARM64 architecture, JDK17, Gradle, actions, five lanes, tests and timeouts; require actual full success on new candidate. No physical macOS15 product support inference.
cloudImpact: No new AOSP VM, storage or test. Standard public-repository runner only.
